title: The hydrogen spectrum
caption: Hydrogen's energy levels, Eₙ = −13.6 eV ÷ n², crowd together towards n = ∞. Electrons falling to n = 1 emit ultraviolet (Lyman series), to n = 2 visible light (Balmer: 656, 486, 434 and 410 nm) and to n = 3 infrared (Paschen). Each line is one jump between two levels.
alt: Energy levels n = 1 to 6, drawn to scale and converging below n = ∞, with downward arrows for the Lyman series to n = 1, the Balmer series to n = 2 and the Paschen series to n = 3.
description: n = 1 at −13.6 eV, n = 2 at −3.40 eV, n = 3 at −1.51 eV, converging at 0.
Lyman series: arrows ending on n = 1 (ultraviolet).
Balmer series: arrows ending on n = 2 (visible).
Paschen series: arrows ending on n = 3 (infrared).
